description: List all comments on a task, newest first. Returns each comment's id, text, author, creation date, assignee and resolved state. Use to read a task's discussion history before replying or to audit activity. Supports cursor pagination via `start` + `start_id`.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

start.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds to page backwards from (cursor). Use the date of the oldest comment already fetched.

start_id.description: Comment ID to start paginating from, used together with `start` to fetch the next page.

task_id.description: ID of the task to read comments from.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_task_comments
